name: Megastore76 Ministry Suite
desc: 5 offline ministry tools and all 11 books by Pastor Mega Philip Mega, in one download, for one price. No internet, no account, no subscription. Everything you type stays on your own computer.

name: Undivided: A One-Year Devotional for Christian Couples Pursuing Their Calling and Their Family
desc: A 365-day devotional for Christian couples pursuing demanding careers, a thriving marriage, and children who know the Lord — undivided.

name: Forgiving Forward: A Christian’s Guide to Releasing Resentment and Finding Freedom
desc: An honest, scripturally-grounded guide to closing the ledger of resentment for good.

name: Dating on Purpose: Courtship, Boundaries, and Discerning God’s Will Before Marriage
desc: Intentional, honest, boundaried dating that treats courtship as a foundation for marriage, not just a path to a wedding.

name: Waiting Well: A Christian’s Guide to Singleness Without Settling
desc: A grace-filled guide that refuses to treat singleness as a waiting room — permission to build a full, purposeful life now.

name: Stories That Build Faith: Bible Accounts That Draw You Closer to God
desc: Thirteen timeless Bible stories, retold to speak directly to the struggles, doubts, and hopes of everyday life today.

name: Unusual Obedience: When God Asks the Unexpected
desc: When God asks the unexpected, will you obey? Pastor Mega Philip Mega explores biblical moments of costly, countercultural obedience — and challenges readers to trust God fully, even when His instructions don’t make sense.

name: Loving Like Jesus: Living Out the Gospel in Every Relationship
desc: Discover the heart of Christ — and live it every day. Pastor Mega Philip Mega challenges believers to move beyond feelings and into sacrificial, Christ-like love that transforms marriages, families, churches and communities.

name: The Christian Journey: Walking in Uncompromising Holiness and Integrity
desc: A bold, practical call to walk with God in uncompromising holiness and integrity, even when the world around you settles for less.

name: God’s Blueprint for a Strong Christian Marriage: A Biblical Guide to Building Love, Trust & Unity That Lasts
desc: A biblical guide to building love, trust and unity that lasts. Pastor Mega Philip Mega unpacks marriage as God’s sacred covenant — not a contract — and shows couples how to build a Christ-centred home through prayer, Scripture and selfless

name: Bringing Up God-Fearing Children: Raising Children Who Love God in a Confused World
desc: Raise children who love God — even in a confused world. Pastor Mega Philip Mega offers biblical, practical guidance for parents who want to build lasting faith at home, from prayer and discipleship to navigating today’s cultural pressures.
